answer: Duplicates are rejected because the token and pigment hash are single-use, so a sock-puppet attacker must acquire and destroy one distinct physical token per fake identity, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. Agents must burn a unique ferrous token minted from a registered shale deposit, each stamped with a random pigment pattern, to submit an epoch claim. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
